Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post #6015). ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

- **Why p2:** `PUT` and `PATCH` answers carry no `X-Request-Id` and lose the 5xx error capture, so an operator cannot trace a failed write.
- **Why `domain:cli`:** `packages/runtime/src/dispatcher-plugin.ts`'s observability Proxy.

Claim: PM loop round 1 · 2026-10-17T14:17Z

Branch: `claude/issue-24025-put-patch-observability`
Worktree: `objectstack-issue-24025`
Domain: `domain:cli`
Seat: `domain:cli#2` (seat post #22648)
File surface (read on `origin/main` `b0fe9fad4`; line numbers move; stop on a breach and explain it in the report): `packages/runtime/src/dispatcher-plugin.ts`, only the observability `Proxy` in `createDispatcherPlugin` (about `:1045-1070`, the `prop === 'get' || prop === 'post' || prop === 'delete'` arm); `packages/runtime/src/observability/instrument.ts`, only if `instrumentRouteHandler` must learn a verb; pins under `packages/runtime/src/`; one `.changeset/24025-*.md`. ⛔ Hold-offs: every route body and mount helper (`mountPackagesRoute`, `registerAIRoutes`, the `/keys` mounts), `packages/plugins/plugin-hono-server`, `packages/rest`.
Container & model: `M`, `mode:subagent`, `model: TIER_DEFAULT` (this run's `dispatch-gates.mjs --tier --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`: "Model tier — no path-derived mandate")
Clause-②: no
Responsibility: `packages/runtime`'s dispatcher `Proxy` wraps only `get`, `post` and `delete` | none for the request id and the 5xx capture; the Hono transport's `afterResponse` keeps only the counter and the histogram | every client of a dispatcher `PUT` or `PATCH` route (`/packages/:id*`, `/automation/:name`, `/ai/*`, `/keys`) and the operator tracing its failures; measured on a stock showcase boot (card body)
Thread-read: 6223713375
Serial constraints cleared: today's predecessors on `dispatcher-plugin.ts`, PR #24149 (`6dede7a51`) and PR #24009 (`9e797a897`), have landed. None of the 4 open PRs touches the file. #24061 (`domain:services`, claim 6234889035) declares `packages/runtime/src/**` for the `me/*` grant resolution, which lives in `domains/auth.ts`, so it does not overlap the `Proxy`. #24143 (seat 1) is `packages/rest/src/data-action-routes.ts`, which does not overlap.
